pair_construction: Build deterministic matched-surface/matched-polarity groups containing opposite registered verdicts. Include same-referent aliases/replacements, obsolete-with-replacement versus obsolete-with-consider-only, lexical/synonym collisions between distinct identifiers, and declared relation cases. If metadata does not determine the semantic verdict, label CANNOT_CHECK rather than author-labeling it.
split: Hash the canonical pair key; low bit DEVELOPMENT, high bit PROTECTED_EVALUATION. Freeze every pair and its machine relation provenance before running candidate mappers.
success_gate: polarity-only must be non-sufficient by construction and the richer registered coordinate rule must improve protected correctness on at least two ontology families without increasing false merges
stop_rule: No semantic label may be inferred from author judgement when the pinned ontology does not encode it; such rows remain CANNOT_CHECK.
